feature.level_2: Runtime and Resource Routing (Bayesian Optimization / Bandits / Cost-Aware RL)
feature.description: Optimizes model, tool, budget, retry, and concurrency decisions. Validate with traces, load tests, and cost–latency metrics.

contract.purpose_user_function: Tune runtime routing parameters such as model/tool choice, budget, retry and concurrency using measured traces.
contract.valid_inputs: Historical route/execution events, capability health, costs, latency, failures, quotas, concurrency policy, candidate routing settings, and eval pack.
contract.expected_outputs: Recommendation/scorecard and approved routing/config change, with before/after cost-latency evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes scorecards/evolution events and may update approved routing policy; live dispatch is handled elsewhere.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Insufficient data, eval/regression failure, budget/policy violation, health degradation, or approval denial blocks change.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Deterministic resource selection and generic evolution exist; Bayesian optimization, bandit, and cost-aware RL implementations were not found.
contract.success_evidence: Before/after traces and guardrails support the recommendation; approved change passes eval/regression and can be reverted.
